body:
## Summary

Gate every push locally with tip-bound verdicts, MR-context consistency checks, and a default-on install. Origin: a "docs-only" MR that carried 13,913 lines of implementation through its review window (kimchi-studio !1025 post-mortem). Spec: ADR 0006 in this PR.

```text
on(git push)
  parse pushed refs + destination remote
  if ref is a deletion
    invalidate that ref's verdicts; allow
  if (remote, ref, tip) has a verdict
    if identical tree OR identical patch-set (rebase)
      carry forward; allow (no reviewer call)
  consult open MR/PR for the branch (read-only gh/glab, 24h cache)
    scope-vs-diff / claimed-count / rewritten-head findings -> BLOCK
    no context -> advisory, proceed
  review base: MR target -> upstream -> origin/HEAD
  run reviewer (config: depth, timeout, failOpen)
  verdict -> (remote, ref, tip) ledger
  block on fail; bypass records to bypasses.jsonl
```

```diff
 scripts/
 ├── install-git-hook.sh          # default-on install, --no-git-hook opt-out, hooksPath chaining
+├── rg_config.py                 # ~/.config/review-gate/config.json: depth/timeout/failOpen
+├── rg_mr_consult.py             # read-only MR/PR consult + consistency findings
 ├── rg_store.py                  # + TTL prune, invalidate_ref, audited bypass records
 └── review-gate.py               # + carry-forward, consult wiring, config consumption, base resolver
 docs/adr/0006-*.md               # decision record (9 decision groups)
 docs/config-reference.md         # config keys, precedence, bypass semantics
 CHANGELOG.md                     # [Unreleased] entry
```

## Evidence

- **Review (two axes, spec + standards):** both `NEEDS_FIXES` on first pass — 13 findings, including the head-mismatch check blocking normal MR iteration. All 13 fixed in `eaea518` and re-verified.
- **Before:** on the maintainer machine, `git config --global core.hooksPath` was unset — pushes from terminals, IDEs, and agent worktrees met zero blocking review. **After:** default-on install arms hooksPath globally and chains husky-style predecessors (test: fake previous hook dir, both hooks fire — `test_pg6_installer.py`, 11 pass).
- **Declared suites:** 204 passed, 1 skipped (Windows `.ps1` twin — none exists).
- **Full regression sweep:** 1,843 passed; the 6 failures reproduce bit-identically on pristine `main` (verified: same 3 failed / 56 passed in those files on base) — zero regressions from this branch.
- **Incident replay:** a push whose branch has an open MR labelled `documentation` with 79 non-`docs/**` paths in the diff is blocked with `MR-CONSISTENCY:` before the reviewer runs (`test_pg5_orchestrator.py` scenario (a)); normal iterative pushes (recorded head is an ancestor of the tip) pass with an advisory.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. All changes are behind the install and config surfaces; the verdict store gains only additive fields (`recorded_at`, restamped lazily).

**Blast Radius:** install-time behavior. The installer now writes global `core.hooksPath` by default (backup + chaining preserved; `--no-git-hook` restores legacy). Fail-closed means an offline machine blocks pushes unless `OCR_FAIL_OPEN=1` is given one-shot (recorded, announced). No remote/CI/webhook side effects.
title: feat(gate): universal local-only push gate — default-on install, tip-bound verdicts, MR-consistency consult
